home.title: Ubuyobozi
home.subtitle: Ubwiza bw'amakuru ni cyo gicuruzwa. Komeza kugezaho urutonde rw'ibikoresho kandi buri mubare ugire aho ukomoka.

submissions.title: Ibiciro byatanzwe
submissions.text: Genzura, wemeze cyangwa wange ibiciro byatanzwe. Ibidasanzwe birangwa mu buryo bwikora.

materials.title: Ibikoresho n'umutungo
materials.text: Ibikoresho, abakozi n'imashini hamwe n'inkomoko, itariki, icyizere n'uko byagenzuwe.

settings.title: Igenamiterere rya porogaramu
settings.text: Ikirango, ibikubiye ku rupapuro rw'itangiriro, ubwoko bw'inyubako n'ibiciro fatizo, imisozo, amatsinda y'imirimo, inyongera, ahantu, ibyiciro by'igereranya, ibipimo by'imari, uburyo bw'akazi n'indimi. Bifite verisiyo.

prices.title: Ibikoresho n'umutungo
prices.subtitle: Ibiciro byemejwe by'ibikoresho, abakozi n'imashini hamwe n'inkomoko, itariki n'icyizere. Byashaje = birenze iminsi 90. Tanga igiciro kugira ngo usabe kukivugurura; abayobozi ba porogaramu barabigenzura bakabitangaza.

submissions.title: Ibiciro byatanzwe
submissions.subtitle: Kwemeza igiciro bitangaza verisiyo nshya kandi bigasimbura igiciro cyemejwe kiriho kuri icyo gikoresho n'aho giherereye.
submissions.flaggedHint: Ibiciro byaranzwe bitandukanye n'igiciro cyemejwe kiriho kurenza 25 %. Banza ugenzure ku yindi nkomoko mbere yo kwemeza.

settings.title: Igenamiterere rya porogaramu
settings.subtitle: Ibyo byose moteri, urutonde rw'ibikoresho n'impapuro rusange bishingiraho. Impinduka zikurikizwa ku igereranya rishya iyo utangaje verisiyo; indangamimerere z'igereranya zisanzwe zikomeza kuboneka uko zari ziri.
settings.contentLanguageHint: Imyanya y'inyandiko iri hano hasi ihindurirwa muri uru rurimi. Umubare uri ku rurimi werekana inyandiko zitarabona ubusobanuro; abasura babona icyongereza kugeza ubwo bubonetse.

branding.title: Ikirango
branding.hint: Kigaragara ku kirango cy'izina, kuri manifeste no ku mutwe wa buri raporo.

homepage.headline: Umutwe w'ingenzi
homepage.statsHint: Imibare igera kuri ine iri iruhande rw'umutwe w'ingenzi.
homepage.stepsHint: Intambwe zifite nimero munsi y'igereranya (zigera kuri esheshatu).
homepage.professionalHint: Igice kigenewe abubatsi b'inyubako, QS n'abarwubatsi.
homepage.exampleHint: Igereranya ry'urugero rigaragara iruhande rw'igice cy'ibanze.

typologies.title: Ubwoko bw'inyubako n'ibiciro fatizo
typologies.hint: Igiciro fatizo cyo kubaka kuri m² ku musozo wa Standard mu hantu fatizo (impamvu 1.00). Ubwoko bwahagaritswe buvanwa mu igereranya rusange ariko imishinga isanzwe ikomeza gukora.

finishes.title: Urwego rw'umusozo
finishes.hint: Igipimo rusange gikoreshwa kuri buri gice keretse hari umurongo wihariye w'igice hano hasi.
finishes.curvesHint: Ibice ikiguzi cyabyo kidakurikiza igipimo rusange (urugero: HVAC ntiba ihari muri Economy).
finishes.blankHint: Siga uburyo bwose bune ubusa kugira ngo hakoreshwe igipimo rusange.

packages.title: Amatsinda y'imirimo
packages.hint: Umugabane w'ikiguzi fatizo cyo kubaka kuri buri tsinda ry'urwego rwa 1 (Igice 5.1). Imigabane igomba kungana na 100 % — ubu ni {{pct}} %.
packages.sumWarning: Imigabane ingana na {{pct}} %. Gutangaza birahagaritswe kugeza igeze kuri 100 % (±2).
packages.phaseNamesHint: Amazina y'ibyiciro mu rurimi rworoshye yerekwa abakiriya.

extras.title: Inyongera
extras.hint: Amafaranga ateganyirijwe ibikorwa by'inyongera. Koresha bumwe muri ubu buryo: umubare uhamye (× impamvu y'ahantu), kuri buri cyumba cyo kuraramo, % by'ifatizo, cyangwa inyongera ku itsinda rimwe ry'ibice.

locations.title: Ahantu n'impamvu z'ibiciro
locations.hint: Impamvu ugereranyije n'ahantu fatizo (1.00). Ahantu hahagaritswe ntihagaragara mu guhitamo ariko imishinga ya kera iracyakora.

classes.title: Ibyiciro by'igereranya
classes.hint: Amazina, kimwe cya kabiri cy'urwego n'amafaranga y'ibitunguranye kuri buri cyiciro (Igice 1.4). Urwego rwa 1 ntirugomba na rimwe gufatwa nka BOQ.
classes.storeyFactorPct: Ikiguzi cy'urusobe kuri buri igorofa ryiyongereye %

workflow.title: Uburyo bw'akazi n'ubwiza bw'amakuru
workflow.blockExport: Hagarika gusohora no gutanga BOQ y'ababigize umwuga igihe cyose hari igiciro cyashaje cyangwa kibura (ikigenderwaho cya 5)
workflow.requireReason: Saba impamvu kuri buri mpinduka y'ingano / igiciro
workflow.approveRoles: Inshingano zemerewe kwemeza no gutanga BOQ

history.title: Amateka ya verisiyo
history.hint: Buri verisiyo yatangajwe hamwe n'inyandiko yayo. Igereranya ribika verisiyo y'amategeko ryabazwe nayo.

publishDialog.title: Tangaza igenamiterere v{{version}}
publishDialog.text: Igereranya rishya rizahita rikoresha aya mategeko. Igereranya ryabitswe rikomeza verisiyo y'amategeko yaryo kandi rikomeza kuboneka uko ryari riri.

resetDialog.title: Subiza ku biteganyijwe mbere?
resetDialog.text: Ikirango, inyandiko, ibiciro n'uburyo bw'akazi byose bisubira ku biteganyijwe mbere nka verisiyo nshya. Verisiyo zabanje zigumana mu mateka.
